title: Student Success Analytics and Data Governance Platform for the Université de Tunis El Manar and Partner Faculties (Phase 2, 2026–2028)
raw_text: L’Université de Tunis El Manar keeps enrolment, attendance and examination results in separate faculty systems, so no one can see why first-year students leave. We require one student data warehouse that combines these sources, an early-warning dashboard that flags students at risk of dropping out, and a data governance framework with a catalogue and a named owner for every dataset. Processing must comply with the national personal data protection law. Faculty administrators must be able to explain every flag to the student concerned.
requirements: Single student data warehouse combining enrolment, attendance and examination results
Early-warning dashboard for students at risk of dropping out
Data governance with a catalogue and a named owner for every dataset
Compliance with the national personal data protection law
